items.title: Responsive sales matrix across roles and target viewports
items.precondition: Isolated worktree app running with deterministic mock identities for owner, admin, manager, and agent.
steps: Open /sales as each role at 320, 360, 390, 768, 1024, and 1440px, plus 844x390 landscape.
Check the route, visible lookup, all four tabs, record presentation, console, and document width.
Open the mobile navigation and filter sheet below 1024px; confirm desktop tables at 1024px and above.
items.expected: Every matrix case renders without page-level horizontal overflow or console errors; mobile uses prioritized records and desktop retains tables.
items.notes: The mobile shell and record presentation remain active through 1023px; the 232px rail and desktop tables return at 1024px.

items.title: Accessible shell, filters, zoom, and keyboard sorting
items.precondition: Owner or admin session at a responsive viewport.
steps: Open and dismiss mobile navigation and secondary filters by keyboard.
Select Dashboard from mobile navigation, then return to /sales.
Apply 200% browser page scale at 390px and inspect page overflow.
At 1024px, focus a sortable table header and press Enter.
items.expected: Overlays return focus, route selection closes navigation, 200% zoom remains contained, and keyboard sorting updates aria-sort.
items.evidence: evidence/primary-flow-results.json; evidence/shell-cross-route-results.json; npm run qa:sales-responsive reported route-selection and aria-sort checks passed.
items.notes: Focused QA was also run with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce for the owner 320px case.

items.title: Lookup, tabs, filters, and mobile record priorities
steps: Confirm search remains immediately visible.
Open Contracts, Payments, Receivables, and Clients at phone, tablet, and desktop widths.
Open the compact secondary-filter sheet below 1024px and inspect the visible record layout.
items.expected: All views remain reachable and scannable, no narrow layout forces a visible table, and no page overflow occurs.
items.evidence: npm run qa:sales-responsive — all tab, filter, table-visibility, and overflow assertions passed; evidence/manager-390.png and evidence/owner-1440.png.
items.notes: Desktop and mobile presenters consume the same filtered row objects and formatters.

items.title: Agent requests a hold at 320px
items.precondition: Agent usr_012 with an available lot and client in deterministic mock data.
steps: Open Request hold at 320x700.
Select an available lot and buyer.
Submit the request and wait for the success state.
items.expected: The dialog stays inside the visual viewport and the hold request completes with observable success.

items.title: Manager posts a payment at 320px
items.precondition: Manager usr_004 with payment:post and an outstanding receivable.
steps: Open Receivables and select Post payment.
Enter a valid amount and submit.
Wait for the posted-payment success state.
items.expected: The payment workflow fits 320x700, preserves the preview, and posts successfully.

items.title: Admin completes contract and nested-client creation at 320px
items.precondition: Admin usr_002 with an available lot and contract:create/client:manage permissions.
steps: Open New contract and select an available lot.
Create a nested client, confirm focus returns to the buyer combobox, and keep the new client selected.
Advance through Terms, Services, and Review by keyboard, then create the contract.
items.expected: Every builder step and footer action stays reachable, nested focus is restored, and contract creation succeeds.
items.notes: Builder and review bounds remained 8,8 to 312,692 inside 320x700.

items.title: Details, invoice, transfer, cancellation, and void dialogs fit mobile
items.precondition: Admin usr_002 on /sales at 390x844 with a contract containing a posted payment.
steps: Open contract details and invoice preview.
Open and safely dismiss ownership transfer and cancellation.
Open and safely dismiss void payment without committing either destructive action.
items.expected: The detail sheet and every nested transaction surface remain inside the viewport with reachable actions.
items.notes: Invoice print CSS is unchanged; the mobile schedule is print-hidden and the existing print table is explicitly retained.

items.title: Repository, data, desktop, and spec-parity gates
items.precondition: Run from codex/sales-screen-responsiveness-execution in the isolated linked worktree.
steps: Run npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json.
Run npm run lint, npm run validate:mock, npm run build, and git diff --check.
Inspect the diff for dependency, route, permission, store, finance, domain, migration, and print-CSS drift.
items.expected: All commands exit successfully; only pre-existing lint warnings remain; implementation matches the approved responsive-only scope.
items.evidence: Typecheck PASS; lint PASS with pre-existing warnings only; validate:mock PASS; build PASS; git diff --check PASS; evidence/shell-cross-route-results.json (29 route-role cases); evidence/owner-1440.png and evidence/admin-1440.png
items.notes: No package-lock, dependency, route, permission, store, finance, domain, schema, or migration changes are present. Local origin/main remains 16 commits ahead and was not synchronized without authorization.
